data.body:
CORRECTION to the previous comment: one command name was lost to shell quoting ("run  for the review-bot role"). The intended text is:

THE DECISIVE TEST, option (a): run

    aws iam simulate-principal-policy \
      --policy-source-arn <the review-bot role ARN> \
      --action-names bedrock:InvokeModel bedrock:Converse bedrock:ConverseStream \
      --resource-arns <the target model/inference-profile ARN>

and confirm the decision for each action. Option (b) is unchanged: apply the scoped grant to a throwaway role and issue a real Converse call from it.

The point stands and is the part that matters: do NOT validate a scoped policy using an identity that holds bedrock:* — a wildcard makes every action succeed and hides exactly this class of error until production, which for story eb6e means a review bot cut over to Bedrock with no Anthropic fallback.
